U.note: Alive at rest with three draggable colored sources, Light/Paint/Naive models, readable mix swatch and probe, and a clean mobile stack.

V.note: Ink mixer with RGB sliders, modes and ramps works, but the canvas opens as an empty black rectangle and the layout is plain with the canvas not filling its card.

W.note: Elegant two-color ratio mix as an ascii disc with a gradient strip and a channel-mean versus linear-light model, but narrow in scope and the model controls fall below the fold.

X.note: Paint-on-canvas mixer with modes, ramps and pick-from-canvas, but it opens as an empty black box in a half-empty white card and does nothing until the user draws.

Y.note: Pre-seeded drops of red, green and blue show additive mixing in colored ascii, with a Light/Paint toggle that swaps the inks to CMY, plus a cell inspector and a good phone layout.

Z.note: Compact two-color comparison of sRGB and linear-light mixing with keyboard shortcuts and hex validation, but the result is small and the ascii is mostly a single repeated tile.
